description: Diorama (50x50): a river valley between forested level-2 to level-6 terraces; two Deep Ore Veins with Deep Mine sites south and east of the start, Deep Ore Sources with Deep Drill sites on the south-east level-4 bench and the east level-6 terrace, the Deep Processor and Steel Mill in the south level-3 pocket, the sandstone quarry on the central level-3 strip, five record caches around the Archive Excavation at the south edge; no reactor or launch pad fits.
